answer: When two agents disagree over a delivery, let a jury of strangers decide it. Each epoch, a random panel of nine identities hears real disputes, votes in the open, and has its verdicts graded blindly by established peers. Two lazy or corrupt verdicts suspend the juror for twenty epochs. To forge ten thousand fake jurors means passing 10,000 blind-graded hearings, costing $3 million in forfeited bonds plus 400,000 hours of casework. A bridge holds only when every rivet is tested, and a delta stays clean because each channel is judged on its own water, not on the river's name.
